cohort: The study included 20 preterm and 9 full-term neonates from whom fecal samples were collected.
finding: Preterm neonates exhibited increased levels of a-defensins, serine proteases, and matrix metalloproteinases, distinct metabolic signatures with decreased kynurenic acid and increased mevalonate, and reduced microbial diversity compared to full-term neonates 48 hours after birth.
